hints.title: Core Idea
hints.text: For small bounds 1 <= a <= b <= 1000, we can check each number x individually.

hints.title: Key Observation
hints.text: A number has unique digits if the length of its string representation equals the count of its distinct characters.

hints.title: Algorithmic Steps
hints.text: Iterate from a to b inclusive and count numbers with unique digits.

hints.title: Implementation

complexity.notes: Direct digit uniqueness checking across the interval.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Digital DP is unnecessary given bounds <= 1000.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: O(1) extra space for small digit set.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Use digit set length to verify unique digits per integer.
